author: session_research_branch
hypothesis: exp024b 剩余截面排序误差中存在可由特征暴露中性化修正的成分:在每个时间截面内,将基线预测秩对 Top-N 高漂移特征的截面秩做线性投影并按小系数 lambda 扣除。该修正作用于特征轴(截面内特征暴露),与已否决的实体轴路线 exp028a(个股身份残差,线上 0.110966)不同。
mechanism: per-section: F = rank01(selected feature columns) centered; beta = lstsq(F, base_rank); candidate = rank01(base_rank - lambda * F @ beta)

adversarial_validation.model: LightGBM binary, 5-fold CV AUC, gain importance

preregistered_parameters.parameter_selection_rule: choose (lambda, N) maximizing pooled fold2+fold3 mean delta subject to fold2>0 and fold3>0 and per-section rank-correlation>=0.995 in folds; official valid is pure holdout reported once with frozen parameters
preregistered_parameters.nan_rank_policy: NaN feature values receive rank 0.5 before centering

baseline_note: fold windows use exp016 static strict-OOF proxy (same as exp024a); official valid uses frozen exp021 full valid prediction; test base is exp024b prediction (valid-side exp024b analog does not exist, mirroring exp024 series convention)
stop_rules: 任何门槛失败即终止该路线,不生成 exp029b
不以事后扩大 lambda 网格、更换特征来源或放宽秩相关门槛复活
official valid 不用于参数选择,只做冻结参数的单次保留验证

compliance.no_future_features: 特征仅取当截面 X(t) 与历史;对抗验证只用 X 特征不用标签
compliance.test_labels: exp029a 不加载 Test 标签;exp029b 仅在门槛全过后生成 prediction

expected_outcome_if_true: fold2/fold3 pooled delta 小幅为正且 official valid 不为负,生成 exp029b 供用户决定是否消耗线上额度
expected_outcome_if_false: 特征暴露已被 exp015/016 稳健秩视图吸收,中性化 delta 在四窗口不一致,按停止规则登记失败并关闭该路线
